params.closure_scale_basis: R3 ledger rings: station 0 / 1 and last-1 / last differ by 0.028-0.031 in half-size (measured, printed in the step-0 log)
params.cap: r6_tess.round_cap(final_max=8, inner_radius=0.3) on the closure end ring, orient_cap against the grid
params.plateau_stations: committed r7-measure.json stations (proposed_N128_delta1mm.stations_m): the first station >= 12.0 m and the following ones
params.tail_centre_basis: R3 ledger tail ring z 4.9242..5.3007 -> centre 5.11245 (rounded to 5.1125)
params.taper: crown, belly and width linear in x between the last plateau station and the tail ring; slope break at the joint is a declared C0 knot
params.taper_ring_spacing: L4 rule: h = min(sqrt(8 delta/kappa), 3P/128, 0.6), |dh/dx| <= 0.18, marched from the joint; last gap shorter than h/2 absorbed
params.feature_edges_for_flip: rings 0, 1, R-2, R-1 (closure end rings and band boundary rings) as closed polylines
params.tessellation: r6_tess.lean_triangles over all rows, then r7_flip.flip_axis_parallel
